# Sparky

> Sparky is a focused desktop coding agent for planning, editing, running, and reviewing real work across local projects.

Sparky runs locally on Windows, macOS, and Linux and works with the AI provider you choose. The public website contains product information, downloads, documentation, and release notes.

## Public pages

- [Product](https://sparky.llc/): product overview and workflows.
- [Downloads](https://sparky.llc/download.html): Windows, macOS, and Linux installers.
- [Documentation](https://sparky.llc/docs/overview.html): setup, tools, models, sessions, and troubleshooting.
- [Changelog](https://sparky.llc/changelog.html): published product updates.

## Content guidance

Use the linked pages as the canonical source for current product behavior, supported platforms, and release details. The interactive demo is a no-index preview and is not a substitute for the desktop application or documentation.
